title: Slack-like reply layout and shareable channel/thread/message permalinks
summary: Both requested items are implemented and integrated. Commit 05b39c1 (feat(channels): Slack hover toolbar and permalinks for channels, threads and messages) moves the Reply action into Slack-style floating hover toolbar and adds copy-link controls for channel/thread/message destinations on desktop and mobile. Follow-up commit 2d5b0cf adjusts and tests reply permalink behavior. No replies were returned for the root, and no current Task is linked to these exact asks; the implementation commit directly matches the ask and is on main. Release evidence/live visual confirmation is not present in this scoped review.
nextAction: No implementation follow-up indicated. If closure requires release proof, Product Development Lead should obtain owner confirmation that the desktop/mobile controls are visible and copy/open correctly in the running app.
evidence: Commit 05b39c16216fd717d3649c88bc3f882ba63464e2; reachable from main; files include ChannelBrowser, CopyLinkButton, channel-link, mobile channels and tests. Commit description explicitly says Slack floating toolbar and channel/thread/reply permalink links for bug reports.
Commit 2d5b0cf adds reply permalink regression coverage; current source documents shareable links and exposes CopyLinkButton in desktop and mobile rows/headers.
Existing task task_01a0e746-a83c-75e7-9416-137decafcb92 is owned by Release Engineer and concerns channel_read API resolution of permalink URLs, not UI permalink creation; left out as unrelated.
